name: Ogham — Advanced — Drink Dry the Earth

system.description:
You can identify sites of power — cromlechs, faerie rings, dragon tracks and the like — and draw spiritual energy from them, though wizards, faeries and Lupines also use these sites, and taking too much energy can leave them barren and lifeless. You must win a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty set by the Storyteller) to discern whether a location can provide power. Once found, expend a Blood Trait to mark the site and attune yourself to it. Thereafter, unless someone interferes with your attunement, you can drain the site's mystical energy whenever you visit, gaining two bonus Traits for every Road Trait you possess. These bonus Traits last until dawn and can be used in any challenges.

Mystic sites vary in power from one to five; each starts with 10 times its rating in bonus Traits, slowly replenished at the Storyteller's discretion. Should a Lhiannan ever drain all of a site's bonus Traits, it becomes barren and lifeless.
